verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
Here is our King
Here is our Love

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
Here is our God who's come
To bring us back to him

verse.name: c1c
verse.lines:
He is the one
He is Jesus

verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
From wherever spring arrives
To heal the ground

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
From wherever searching comes
To look itself

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
A trace of what we're looking for
So be quiet now, and wait

verse.name: p1
verse.lines:
The ocean is growing
The tide is coming in
Here it is:

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
And what was said to the rose
To make it unfold

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
Was said to me, here in my chest
So be quiet now, and rest
